Plan the bias. Trade the session. Review the truth.

A trading journal built around the session, not just the trade. Map your morning bias, review every entry with intent, watch your edge in blocks of ten, hold yourself to your own risk rules — and post the whole thing to your community in one tap.

Bias & Review

Plan it before the candle. Grade it after.

Write your read while your head is clear — mode, structure, location, direction. After the close, grade the session and each trade: execution, focus, mindset and an honest reflection.

  • Morning bias linked to your HTF + LTF charts
  • Execution, focus and mindset tagged per trade
  • One tap to post bias and review to the community

Series of 10 & Statistics

Find your edge, in tens.

One trade tells you nothing; ten tell you plenty. Your trades are grouped into series of ten and broken down by symbol, day, direction and setup — and the Edge Adjuster shows what holding longer or moving your stop later would really have paid.

  • Win rate, net R, profit factor and expectancy — per series and lifetime
  • Breakdowns by symbol, weekday, direction and setup
  • “What if” tests in real money, on your own trades

03
MT5 Auto-Sync

Your trades log themselves.

Run the Minimalist Manager EA and every trade you close in MetaTrader 5 lands in your journal — entry, exit, risk, R and P&L already filled in. You just add the why. Included on every plan, and in the free trial.

  • Closed trades arrive on their own — no CSV exports
  • Open trades show live while your session runs
  • Result, R, risk and costs filled in from the trade
  • Trading several prop accounts? The EA copies each trade to all of them, each at its own risk

The Session Terminal community

Built for the room, not the marketing page.

Session Terminal grew out of a Discord channel, where it became clear that the community's most successful traders were the ones who held themselves accountable for their actions — bias in the morning, review at the close, everything shared in the same channel. The two companion tools come from the same place.

Comes with Session Terminal

Two free companion tools from the same workshop, made to sit alongside the journal — set your charts and your terminal to match how you review.

TradingView · Pine v6

Minimalist indicator

Premium & discount zones, volume profile to identify where liquidity is held, previous Day/Week/Month highs & lows, sessions, market-open gaps and yearly quarters — a clean SMC overlay, published free on TradingView.
MetaTrader 5

Minimalist Manager EA

A trade-management utility for MT5 that unleashes the full potential of your journal, published on the MQL5 Market — open trades, choose your SL size and TP, and once you're in a trade, automate the move to break-even. Set a max trades-per-day limit to stop you from over-trading.
